title: Minimal Footprint Enforcement: Measuring Whether Agents Voluntarily Restrict Their Own Resource Acquisition

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: resource over-acquisition is a precursor to unsafe autonomy escalation. Measuring it and testing a simple mitigation (system prompt instructions) directly addresses a METR-flagged dangerous capability indicator. Actionable for agent deployment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing 20 tasks with tool subsets and measuring over-acquisition is straightforward API-based evaluation. System prompt modification is trivial. Uses existing frontier model APIs. Well within beginner reach with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: a table of over-acquisition rates per model with and without system prompt intervention. 20 tasks is manageable. Single experimental paradigm. Well-scoped for 30 hours.
